question:
Which of the following numbers will come in place of question mark (?) in the given series?

5, 8, ?, 23, 35, 50, 68
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive multiple of (3) are added subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ee159cc78a987b324559f861a61641005b7f02460f9375573b16c5cf8d776e.png] 

Hence, **"14"** is the correct answer.
